# `features/resource`

A record's index or show page needs its standard shell — header, actions bar and sections.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A record's index or show page needs its standard shell — header, actions bar and sections.
- **Avoid when:** The page is a workspace shell, or the content is one table.
- **Consider instead:** `layout/page`, `features/data-view`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { ResourceActionBar } from "themelia-ui/features/resource"
import "themelia-ui/features/resource.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/avatar`, `base/display`, `base/feedback`, `base/navigation`, `base/structure`, `base/typography`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

### `ResourceShellSlots`

Kind: interface.

Regions a screen can replace outright. Each has a generated default; replace it when the
header or empty state is not the generated shape.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `header` | no | `ReactNode` | Replaces the generated identity header. |
| `toolbar` | no | `ReactNode` | Replaces the toolbar region, including a tabbed shell's own tab row. |
| `aside` | no | `ReactNode` | Related context beside the primary column, when the container is wide enough. |
| `footer` | no | `ReactNode` | After the body. |
| `loading` | no | `ReactNode` |  |
| `empty` | no | `ReactNode` |  |
| `error` | no | `ReactNode` |  |

## Preview recipes

Preview route: Resource shells — `/resource`

### ResourceIndexShell

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<ResourceIndexShell
  title="Invoices"
  description="Everything billed on this account."
  actions={<Button>New invoice</Button>}
  loading={isLoading}
  error={error}
  empty={rows.length === 0}
  onRetry={refetch}
  toolbar={<ResourceActionBar leading={<SearchInput />} />}
>
  <InvoiceTable rows={rows} />
</ResourceIndexShell>
```
